about: A judge that refuses every graph as cyclic: every check that must accept, and every one that must name another rule, fails.

mutations.find: export const graphFinding = (c) => ((r) => (r ? { rule: r.rule, say: r.say(c) } : null))(GRAPH_RULES.find((x) => x.fails(c)));
mutations.replace: export const graphFinding = () => ({ rule: "PLAN_CYCLE", say: "every graph is refused" });
